description: A city employs seasonal and permanent snow removers. A seasonal snow remover works 6 hours per shift and gets paid $120. A permanent snow remover works 10 hours per shift and gets paid $250. Currently the city needs 300 hours of snow remover labor after a heavy snowfall. If the city has a budget of $6500, how many of each type of worker should be hired to minimize the total number of snow removers?

HoursSeasonal.definition: Number of hours per shift for a seasonal snow remover

PaymentSeasonal.definition: Payment per shift for a seasonal snow remover

HoursPermanent.definition: Number of hours per shift for a permanent snow remover

PaymentPermanent.definition: Payment per shift for a permanent snow remover

RequiredLaborHours.definition: Total required labor hours after a heavy snowfall

TotalBudget.definition: Total budget available for hiring snow removers

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of snow removers hired (seasonal and permanent combined)"
